problem: "文件不懂的地方" is missing 里 and a subject; unnatural.
suggested_fix: {W}里我们不懂的地方，明天问老板吧。

suggested_fix: use plural: I want to go through last year's {Es} this weekend / last year's {Es} might take / start with the most important ones

problem: English singular "last year's questionnaire ... take more than a day to sort" is unnatural; needs plural.
suggested_fix: use {Es}: go through last year's {Es}; start with the most important ones

problem: "写完问卷" is wrong; you fill in (填) a questionnaire, not write it.
Backing up "your own questionnaires" on computer and phone makes little sense.
"用汉语我不知道" is not natural Chinese.
"说慢一点汉语" is ungrammatical (object after the complement).
"汉语我懂了" would mean "I have understood the language"; not "I get it now".
"the phone number of that tuition" is not natural English for classes.
"this tuition ... cheaper than other tuition" uses mass noun with demonstrative; unnatural.
"take a harder tuition" is wrong English (mass noun with article).

problem: "this result" singular for 成绩 (grades/results); "the result isn't the most important thing" a bit off.
"your result has gotten a lot better" is unnatural; should be plural "results/grades".
suggested_fix: use {Es}: your {Es} have gotten a lot better

problem: "this result" for exam grades; needs "results/grades".
"ask about my result every single day", "topic of result", "stop talking about the result" are unnatural English.
suggested_fix: use {Es}: ask about my {Es}; whenever {Es} come up; stop talking about {Es}

problem: "this result is ten points lower" better as grades/results.
Telling "the boss" to change the class does not fit a class.
"give my child good education" lacks an article; reads ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Right, I can buy fewer things, but I want to give my child a good {E}.

problem: "人文成绩" is not a normal collocation (人文 is not a subject name like 科学).
suggested_fix: 我女儿的人文课成绩特别好，老师常常表扬她。

problem: "人文有很大的变化" / news discussing 人文 is vague and odd for humanities; fits science better.
"organisms" in a park is not how friends talk; gloss too technical.
"tiny organisms in the mountains" is stiff English; "creatures" is natural.
"几个话" uses the wrong measure word; it should be 几句话.
"学文字/练习文字" is not a normal collocation; 文字 is not something you learn like 汉字.
"教我一些文字 / 学好文字" is wrong; 文字 does not mean "some characters to teach".
English singular "the noun" for 名词 (nouns in general); "always get the noun wrong" is unnatural.
suggested_fix: use plural {Es}: I always get {Es} wrong; the part that covers {Es}; go over {Es} again

problem: A Chinese character is not placed at the beginning or end of a sentence; "这种汉字一般不放在最后" makes no sense.
"finish the whole topic", "done more than half of the topic" is unnatural for 课题.
"finally finished the topic" unnatural for 课题.
"下个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 下周 / 下个星期).
suggested_fix: 下{W}你有什么打算？ / 下{W}我想去旅行，你呢？ / 下{W}我也想出去，我们一起走吧。

problem: "这个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 这周 / 这个星期).
suggested_fix: 这{W}你那儿的天气怎么样？ / 这{W}常常下雨，你要带伞。 / 好，我这{W}都带伞。

problem: "这个周" is not natural; 周 does not take 个 (say 这周).
suggested_fix: 你这{W}忙不忙？ / 很忙，这{W}我要加班。 / 辛苦了，这{W}过去就好了。

problem: "Match starts in three seconds, sit down and wait out three seconds" is silly for seconds.
Prompt says ask if he got a new car, but the line asks whether his car is new.
suggested_fix: Say okay and ask him if his car is new.

problem: "这辆车很多钱" is not correct Chinese (should be 很贵 / 要很多钱).
"开车子" and "停车子" are not natural (开车/停车); 车子 does not take these verbs.
"洗车子" is less natural than 洗车.
Shared bikes belong to a company; "someone forgot to take it" and "whose shared bike" do not fit.
"开车子" (three times) is not natural Chinese; should be 开车.
"这个公共汽车" should use the measure 辆/趟.
suggested_fix: 不坐这辆{W}了，等人少的吧。

problem: B does not answer "where is the farthest place", only says somewhere far.
suggested_fix: 坐{W}去过很远的地方，比如西藏，花了很多时间。

problem: Buses are not known for keeping time; "bus is more punctual so we won't be late" does not fit well.
An adult friend being "nervous and excited" about the first bus ride and watching scenery the whole way does not fit a bus.
交通 here means getting around/transportation; "Do you know the traffic around here? / get to know the traffic" is not natural English.
suggested_fix: Do you know how to get around here? I'm new. / A little. Getting around here isn't hard. / I'll walk around more and get to know the area.

problem: "the traffic here used to be really inconvenient" mixes traffic and transportation.
suggested_fix: Yes, getting around here used to be really inconvenient.

problem: "用手机看看交通" does not mean checking a route; it conflicts with "so we don't go the wrong way".
"交通比较轻松" is not a normal way to describe traffic (顺/不堵).
suggested_fix: 是的，那个时候大家都在上班，{W}比较顺。

problem: "any good itinerary" is ungrammatical (singular countable without article).
suggested_fix: Do you have any good {Es} to recommend? I'd like to go somewhere with fewer people.

problem: "今天的雪不好" is odd; people say 雪太大 or 天气不好.
suggested_fix: 今天{W}太大了，我不想出去。

problem: "那有这么大的雪" is awkward.
suggested_fix: 那这么大的{W}，我明天也不去了。

problem: "the snow here changes too fast / changes a lot" does not make sense for snow (fits climate/weather).
"夏天因为晴天，我就不想出去" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 我也是，夏天一遇到{W}，我就不想出去。

problem: Wanting cloudy weather "so we can leave early" is a non sequitur.
"Cloudy" does not follow from "phone says it won't rain".
"今年的雪变化很大 / 雪真的在变，大家要注意身体" makes no sense for snow; belongs to climate.
"今年的雨变化很大 / 雨真的在变，大家要注意身体" makes no sense for rain; belongs to climate.
"finally" is the wrong sense for sentence-initial 最后; English wants "in the end".

"And finally, did you do it together?" is unnatural English; 最后 means "in the end".
Talking about where to eat "for ages" and then "last year decided/went again" does not make sense; fits 当时 only.
"我明天很累" / "I'm so tired tomorrow" is odd for tomorrow.
Eating hot pot in the late morning is odd.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tickets for tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.
"tomorrow late morning" is not natural English.

suggested_fix: Say you two should eat together after she finishes.

problem: Prompt "when she is able to finish" is odd.
suggested_fix: Say OK, she should let you see it once she has finished.

problem: Prompt "once she is able to finish eating" is odd.
suggested_fix: Say OK, once she has finished eating you will go to the supermarket.

problem: English says "laptop" but the Chinese is 电脑 (computer).

"到底谁先赢？" makes no sense when both are on the same team and about to win together.
"Will we not have time to catch it?" is unnatural; the slot gloss leaks into the English.
suggested_fix: Won't we make it? / We won't make this train.

problem: "那我们来不及吃完饭再写吗" is clumsy and illogical.
"will we not have time to finish writing" is unnatural; slot gloss leaks into English.
suggested_fix: Do you think we won't be able to finish it tonight?

problem: "Will we not have time to buy anything?" is unnatural; slot gloss leaks.
suggested_fix: Won't we make it in time to buy anything?

problem: "他是怎么变成了好老师的" is ungrammatical (了 inside 是...的).
suggested_fix: 太好了，他是怎么{W}好老师的？

problem: "怎么会变成了这样的人" has an awkward 会...了.
suggested_fix: 以前那么好，怎么会{W}这样的人？

problem: "不应该让它变成了大问题" uses 了 wrongly after a negative modal.
suggested_fix: 对不起，不应该让它{W}大问题。

problem: "别让它变成了大问题" is wrong; imperative takes no 了.
Prompt "who she treat as" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Ask her who she treats as her best friend.

problem: Prompt "what she treat as" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Say you'd like to ask what she treats as the most important thing.

problem: "不想让工作变成了…" wrongly uses 了 with 不想让.
suggested_fix: 我不想让工作{W}我生活的全部。

problem: "别让工作变成了一切" wrongly uses 了 in a prohibition.
suggested_fix: 所以要多出去玩，别让工作{W}一切。

problem: "怎么让小店成为了最有名的店的" has 了 inside a ...的 construction; ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 你是怎么让小店{W}最有名的店的？

problem: "别让这里成为了更乱的地方" wrongly uses 了 in a prohibition.
suggested_fix: 我们应该做点什么，别让这里{W}更乱的地方。

problem: "他是怎么成为了画家的" has 了 inside 是...的; ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 真的！可是他是怎么{W}画家的？

problem: "就是这样成为了画家的" has 了 inside 是...的; ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: 他每天画画，从不放弃，就是这样{W}画家的。

problem: "带动一些变化" is an odd collocation; 带动 goes with 发展/经济/生意.
"带动不少客人" is not a collocation (带来客人); 带动 takes things like 生意/消费.
suggested_fix: 对，我觉得它还会{W}周围小店的生意。

problem: "带动更多的工作机会" is stretched; usually 带来/创造 工作机会.
suggested_fix: 我同意，希望它也能{W}更多人的就业。

problem: "我只能超过五公里" is illogical; B means she can only run about five km.
"做到不了" is wrong; the potential form is 做不到.
"跑步记录" should be 纪录 (a record to break).
suggested_fix: 他的跑步纪录这么好，以后有人能{W}吗？

problem: Prompt "where she did grow up" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Ask her where she grew up, since her Chinese is so good.

problem: "看运气" about Spring Festival contradicts "doctor says only March".
"运作得很快" is not natural; 运作 goes with 顺利/正常/良好, not speed; English "work fast" odd.
suggested_fix: 你觉得这家公司，以后会{W}得很顺利吗？

problem: "让学校运作得更快 / 看着它慢慢运作" is not natural; 运作 does not go with 快.
suggested_fix: 新来的校长，能让学校{W}得更好吗？

problem: "小组会运作得更快 / 运作得快" is not natural.
suggested_fix: 要是大家都帮忙，你们小组会{W}得更顺利吗？

problem: "让你这么笑" is not natural; say 笑成这样 / 这么开心.
Prompt "why she did get sick again" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Ask her why she is sick again when you have only just got back.

problem: "your grades will raise" is wrong English (intransitive "raise"); also the prompt "make his grades raise".
suggested_fix: Do more problems, ask the teacher more, and your grades will go up.

problem: "家人也会同意的" is a non sequitur in a job-search exchange.
"加强服务质量" is not a standard collocation (提高服务质量); 加强 takes 服务/管理.
"加强服务质量" is not a standard collocation.
"加强服务质量" is not a standard collocation.
"your spending will reduce" uses "reduce" intransitively; wrong English.

problem: "damage the mood" is not natural; people say spoil/ruin the mood.
"如果以后要破坏，我一定先问你" makes no sense; nobody needs to damage files.
"我们转变一下吧" with no object is unclear; people do not suggest "changing" differing ideas this way.
"取代一下" is unnatural; 取代 does not take 一下.
English "about to end" does not match Chinese "结束的时候".
suggested_fix: OK, give me a shout when it ends.

problem: "come out when it's time to end" is unnatural; Chinese says once it ends.
suggested_fix: Okay, come out once it's over.

problem: "stop the game at 9 am because the weather is nicer" is illogical (it would be start); "你们觉得呢" addresses a group.
"明天我们要坚持新的训练了" is odd; 坚持 means keep at something, not start a new training.
A2 says either Zhang or Gao is fine, but B just said the baby will be Zhang like the father.
"有件事我一定要通知你 / 为什么突然要通知我 / 没什么" is incoherent for 通知 (there is something to notify, then "nothing").
"There's one thing I have to congratulate you on ... it's nothing" is contradictory.
"你是想开玩笑吗？" then "我还以为你要开玩笑呢" after "我只是想开玩笑" is incoherent for 开玩笑.
Praising a friend ("你是不是想表扬我", "你以后也不要表扬我") is unnatural; 表扬 is top-down.
"我为什么要表扬你呢 / 我永远不会表扬你" is hostile and makes no sense between friends.
English "I didn't want to ask you" is past tense but Chinese 不想问你 is present.
suggested_fix: Sorry, I don't want to ask you.

problem: "很会回答 / 喜欢回答 / 比我们小时候会回答" is not natural; 回答 does not describe a child's skill.
Prompt "if she'll answer wrong" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Tell her it's fine if she answers wrong, the teacher will help.

problem: Prompt "if she has apply for the visa" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Ask her if she has applied for the visa for her trip abroad.

problem: "A party doesn't get boring when someone will raise ideas" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: That's great. A party doesn't get boring when someone comes up with ideas.

problem: Prompt "what she usually call" is ungrammatical.
suggested_fix: Ask her what she usually calls the noodle maker.

problem: "我想让它称为爷爷的汤" is awkward; 称为 follows 把 (把它称为) or use 叫.
suggested_fix: 这个新做的汤，我想把它{W}爷爷的汤，可以吗？

problem: "什么都别提到" is unnatural as a prohibition (什么都别提).
"分享一把伞" is not natural Chinese; people say 共用/撑一把伞.
"make public your location" is unnatural word order; slot gloss leaks.
"make public its prices / shops that make public all their prices" is unnatural word order.
发表 does not go with a company decision ("决定不能发表", "把决定发表给大家"); the word would be 公布/宣布.
"分享同学们的作品 / 分享我画的画" is odd; the module needs 展出/展示.
传播 is spontaneous spreading; "他们明天会传播这个消息" as a scheduled act sounds odd.
展现 does not go with survey results ("明天要展现 / 怎么展现"); 展示 would.
Prompt "she can talk really well" does not match 你讲得很好 (you spoke well).
suggested_fix: Tell her she spoke really well.

problem: "他要讲话什么" is ungrammatical (讲话 is verb-object).

problem: "他要讲话很久" is ungrammatical; say 讲很久.
suggested_fix: 不知道，听说他要讲很久，你最好早点到。

problem: B was asked for a recommendation but says she will recommend it to friends; it does not answer A.
suggested_fix: 昨天看了一个有趣的，我可以推荐给你。

problem: "你请客的时候我去洗澡" makes no sense for 请客 (treating at a restaurant); module fits cooking.
"下次去更好的地方，我来打包" does not make sense for packing leftovers; fits 点菜.
"pick up food (for guests)" is not natural English; say put food on someone's plate / help yourself.

problem: "pick up food for you" is not natural English; say put food on your plate.
suggested_fix: use "put food on others' plates" gloss

problem: "读新闻" is not natural; people say 看新闻 (读 suggests reading aloud/studying).
"读新闻" is not natural; people say 看新闻.
"我不太懂这个，你可以帮我搬一下吗" is a non sequitur for moving things.
"我不太懂这个，你可以帮我尝一下吗" is a non sequitur for tasting.
"一个队要组成十一个人" is ungrammatical; should be 由十一个人组成.
suggested_fix: 来啊，不过一个队要由十一个人{W}，够吗？

problem: "帮我合并一下这里的东西" makes no sense; one does not merge a pile of stuff.
"把这些资料安排一下 / 你安排前面" is odd for documents; 整理 would fit.
"很难安排在一起 / 把想法安排起来" is odd for ideas.
"Last time only four people make up the group" has the wrong tense.
suggested_fix: That's enough. Last time the group was only made up of four people.
